culpritSource.quote: The murderer/culprit is Sadao Kujirai. He entered the ship as an old man to create an illusion that Kanou, the Organizer of the Shadows, was on board. He then proceeded with his plans and invited Teruyoshi Kameda to the maintenance room where he was killed. He hid the body in a box at the rear of the ship. He then came back to the group and arranged a meeting with Korehisa Kanie, who he drugged. He took Kanie's watch and clothes and placed them on Kameda to make it appear that Kanie was the burned corpse.

motive.quote: Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi.

method.quote: It appeared as though Kujirai had been shot in the arm, though that was also a set up by Kujirai who had shot himself earlier when he killed Kanie.

evidence.quote: It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral.

motive.zhHans: 此后，Ebina 一直在寻找那伙劫匪，并打算用炸弹把他们全部炸死，为他心爱的 Yoshimi 复仇。在他、Kanie 和 Kameda 杀害 Saizo Kano 之后，他杀害同伙的动机是独吞劫匪抢来的全部钱款，并报复已死的 Kano——Kano 曾羞辱过 Kujirai、把他当成傻瓜。Samezaki 指出，Kujirai 之所以失败，是因为他在抢劫案追诉时效刚过就动手杀人，结果除了原来的抢劫罪，如今还要为杀人罪负被捕之责。Samezaki 又说，Kujirai 从来没有赢过 Saizo Kano 的可能——他被骗了整整二十年。此外还注意到，Kujirai 用香烟来布置各种机关，例如烧掉旗帜等场景。
motive.en: Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi. After he, Kanie, and Kameda murdered Saizo Kano, his motive for killing his accomplices was to usurp all the money the robbers stole and to spite the dead Kano, who had humiliated Kujirai and viewed him as an idiot. Samezaki reveals that Kujirai failed because committing murders right after the statute of limitations for the robbery expired makes him now liable for arrest for murder in addition to the original robbery. Samezaki then said that Kujirai never had a chance to win over Saizo Kano, since he had been fooled for twenty years. Also noted is Kujirai's use of cigarettes in order to accomplish the set-ups, such as the burning flag and other scenarios.

method.zhHans: 表面上 Kujirai 手臂中了一枪，但那也是他自导自演——他在杀害 Kanie 时先朝自己开了一枪。Samezaki 指出，报纸上用的那个化名其实就是「Saizo Kano」这几个字把汉字倒过来写的。他脱掉了身上所有衣物以免溺水，只留下裤子与和叶做的护身符，并用手电筒发出灯光信号。
method.en: It appeared as though Kujirai had been shot in the arm, though that was also a set up by Kujirai who had shot himself earlier when he killed Kanie. Samezaki reveals that the alias used in the paper was in fact the name Saizo Kano, if it, written in kanji, was turned around. He took off all of his clothes to stop himself from drowning, save for his pants and the charm made by Kazuha, and used a flashlight to make light signals.

evidence.zhHans: 经揭示，Nagisa Isogai 是 Kano 的女儿；而 Minoru Ebina 与 Toji Samezaki 的女儿 Yoshimi 有过恋情，Yoshimi 在二十年前的抢劫案中被枪杀，Samezaki 认出他就是葬礼上从头哭到尾的那个年轻人。所幸炸弹被柯南发现，并在距船 100 码处被引爆。平次无意中发现了 Kanie 的尸体，Kujirai 因此想杀他，平次被抛入海中。最终揭示，平次被抛入海中后活了下来。
evidence.en: It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral. Fortunately, the bomb was discovered by Conan and was detonated 100 yards from the ship. Heiji had inadvertently found Kanie's body, and Kujirai tried to kill him as a result Heiji was thrown overboard. In the end, it is revealed that Heiji survived being tossed into the sea.

resolution.zhHans: 最终，在目睹一场爆炸、并发现两具尸体之后，柯南解开案件，意识到犯人有两人：一人是炸弹犯，一人是杀人犯。经揭示，Nagisa Isogai 是 Kano 的女儿；而 Minoru Ebina 与 Toji Samezaki 的女儿 Yoshimi 有过恋情，Yoshimi 在二十年前的抢劫案中被枪杀，Samezaki 认出他就是葬礼上从头哭到尾的那个年轻人。此后，Ebina 一直在寻找那伙劫匪，并打算用炸弹把他们全部炸死，为他心爱的 Yoshimi 复仇。所幸炸弹被柯南发现，并在距船 100 码处被引爆。
resolution.en: In the end, after witnessing a bombing and discovering two dead bodies, Conan solves the case, realizing there were two separate culprits: one as the bomber, and one as the murderer. It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral. Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi. Fortunately, the bomb was discovered by Conan and was detonated 100 yards from the ship.

summary.en: A man known as the Organizer of the Shadows is shot to death by his three subordinates. Twenty years later, Conan helps Ran and Kogoro solve a puzzle for which the prize is an all-expense-paid trip on a giant boat built for a small number of people. After eleven people have entered the boat, the boat sets sail. Kogoro meets an inspector that he used to work with on the boat and finds that Heij is on the boat as well. After a passenger is murdered, they learn that a man named Saizou Kanou, the Organizer of the Shadows, is on the boat.

suspects: Toji Samezaki, Minoru Ebina, Sadao Kujirai, and Nagisa Isogai
suspectsZh: 鲛崎东治、海老名实、鲸井贞夫与矶贝渚
